scope: One AC1027 TABLECONTENT cell with a cell-scope TABLEFORMAT margin override and no other non-default style properties.

profile.scope: the single row's single cell, style type 1

implementation.writer: The AC1027 TABLECONTENT writer accepts only this cell-style margin profile in addition to the previously supported default scope. It emits the exact TABLEFORMAT common prefix, CONTENTFORMAT, margin flag, MARGIN/CELLMARGIN_BEGIN, six ordered group-40 values, empty border count, and closing marker. Other non-default cell-style properties remain refused.
implementation.validation: ASCII and binary output are checked for the exact physical group sequence and fresh typed readback of all six values.
implementation.negativeControl: A negative horizontal margin refuses without replacing the destination sentinel. Restoring the selected positive margin profile permits export on the same writer.
